name: Smirk Wink
description: Smirking face paired with winking face is the flirty-playful combo — 'I am up to something, just between us.'
meaning: Used to express flirty playfulness or conspiratorial amusement. The smirk adds 'I am up to something' and the wink adds the 'just between us' beat.
seoDescription: What does 😏😉 mean? The smirking face and winking face combo explained. Used to express flirty playfulness.

longForm.overview:
😏😉 is the flirty-playful combo. The smirking face (😏) reads as 'I am up to something' and the winking face (😉) adds the 'just between us' beat, together forming the visual for conspiratorial flirtation. On Instagram, Twitter, and iMessage 😏😉 shows up under playful posts, flirty moments, and any context where the sender wants to mark a conspiratorial beat. The combo is more flirty than 😏 alone (which can be a generic smirk) and more conspiratorial than 😉 alone (which can be a single wink).

The combo also doubles as a way to react when a sender wants to land as playful-flirty without sliding into the performative drama of 😘 alone (which is more kissing). The smirk-wink pairing keeps the combo on-theme for flirty-playfulness, which is why 😏😉 is the default for any conspiratorial moment. Writers should default to 😏😉 when the moment really is flirty-playful, and reach for 😏 or 😉 alone when the read should be lighter.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
😏😉 arrives as a stand-alone reaction, sandwiched in a sentence as a beat ('trust me 😏😉'), or stacked under a playful post. The combo is the go-to reaction to anything that prompts flirty-playful — a playful moment, a flirty joke, a conspiratorial text, a private wink. It also works as the closer on a thread where the sender wants to land as fully flirty.

In friend group chats 😏😉 works as the shared playful reaction when someone shares a flirty moment. The combo also pairs naturally with 💋 for the 'kiss' beat and with ❤️ for the 'love' emphasis. The combo is rarely used in formal or professional contexts because the flirty-playful will not land safely.
longForm.whenNotToUse:
Skip 😏😉 in cold work channels where the flirty-playful will read as unprofessional. Avoid it in customer-facing comms where the recipient may read it as flirtation when the sender is just being friendly. And do not default to 😏😉 when a softer reaction (🙂, 🤝) would do the same job without the explicit flirty-playful energy.

Also avoid 😏😉 when the recipient has just shared bad news and you want to be supportive — the flirty-playful can read as tone-deaf in that context. Reach for 🤍 or 🙏 when the moment warrants care without the flirty undercurrent. And never send 😏😉 to a contact who has not explicitly opened the door to that energy.
longForm.howToReply:
Mirror 😏😉 with another 😏😉 or with 😉 to keep the flirty-playful going, or upgrade with a sentence that engages with the conspiratorial moment. If you receive 😏😉 and want to slow the bit down, reply with a softer 🤝 or a 'what do you mean?' to pull the conversation back to literal mode.

If the 😏😉 landed on a public post you shared, you can ask 'too flirty?' and most people will clarify that they meant it affectionately. If you want to send 😏😉 as a soft friendly reaction, anchor the combo with a sentence that names what is so flirty so the conspiratorial beat does not feel performative.

faqs.question: What does 😏😉 mean?
faqs.answer: 😏😉 means the sender is being flirty-playful. The smirk adds 'I am up to something' and the wink adds 'just between us,' forming the universal conspiratorial-flirty visual.

faqs.question: Is 😏😉 flirty?
faqs.answer: Yes, 😏😉 is one of the more flirty combos. Inside an established relationship it is the default playful-flirty signal.

faqs.question: What does 😏😉 mean from a girl?
faqs.answer: From a girl, 😏😉 means she is being flirty-playful. There is no universal 'flirty' meaning; the read depends on who is sending it and what they are reacting to.

faqs.question: What does 😏😉 mean on Instagram?
faqs.answer: On Instagram 😏😉 is the flirty-playful reaction. It is most common as a comment on a flirty post to mark the conspiratorial beat.
